import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
breed_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color='steelblue')
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed')
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
age_order = df.groupby('AlterVHundLang')['AlterVHundSort'].first().sort_values().index
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
ax2.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='coral')
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)

# 3. Dogs by District
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
district_counts = df.groupby(['KreisLang', 'KreisSort']).size().reset_index(name='count').sort_values('KreisSort')
ax3.bar(district_counts['KreisLang'], district_counts['count'], color='mediumseagreen')
ax3.set_xlabel('District')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Dog Gender Distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Owner Age Distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
owner_age_order = df.groupby('AlterV10Lang')['AlterV10Sort'].first().sort_values().index
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().reindex(owner_age_order)
colors_bar = plt.cm.viridis(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax5.barh(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values, color=colors_bar)
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax5.set_yticklabels(owner_age_counts.index)
ax5.set_xlabel('Number of Owners')
ax5.set_ylabel('Owner Age Group')
ax5.set_title('Distribution of Dog Owners by Age', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.invert_yaxis()

# 6. Trend over Years
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
yearly_counts = df.groupby('StichtagDatJahr').size()
ax6.plot(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='darkviolet')
ax6.fill_between(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='darkviolet')
ax6.set_xlabel('Year')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations')
ax6.set_title('Dog Registrations Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis - Zurich, Switzerland', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
